name: NestNyx
description: Shared-folder-scoped rclone execution API for Nyx

NYX_API_KEY.description: Secret key required in the X-Nyx-Key header.

RCLONE_CONFIG_B64.description: Base64-encoded rclone.conf. Keep this only in Heroku config vars.

NYX_SHARED_ROOTS_JSON.description: JSON map of logical area names to rclone remote/root and optional expectedOwner.
